### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **2** package(s): `@objectstack/platform-objects`, `@objectstack/plugin-auth`, touching **83** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **2** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/package.json`, `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/sso-oidc-refusal-cause.ts`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**30** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 0eca80a707822bf635b43ee6347109a87f48c0af`.

⛔ **8** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **2** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/package.json`, `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/sso-oidc-refusal-cause.ts`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **11** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **65** of **246** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **181** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **181**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **122** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **24** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 0eca80a707822bf635b43ee6347109a87f48c0af` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `11ba9f72dd93b83552825cb35ed26d1821f8181b` — the merge of head `8cd810b056c6eda150ae5eab8b843fc13b5eb3d7` into base `0eca80a707822bf635b43ee6347109a87f48c0af`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 11ba9f72dd93b83552825cb35ed26d1821f8181b && git checkout 11ba9f72dd93b83552825cb35ed26d1821f8181b
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 0eca80a707822bf635b43ee6347109a87f48c0af 8cd810b056c6eda150ae5eab8b843fc13b5eb3d7 && git checkout -B drift-repro 0eca80a707822bf635b43ee6347109a87f48c0af && git merge --no-ff 8cd810b056c6eda150ae5eab8b843fc13b5eb3d7

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 0eca80a707822bf635b43ee6347109a87f48c0af
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 0eca80a707822bf635b43ee6347109a87f48c0af` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `811d140c2707a216975f24b7efc3f3659c1c1216`
Local-runs: none

### ① Derived judgments

- **Face:** declaration. There is no published schema and no governed path (`check-governed-merges --pr 32188`: 0 of 41 paths). The review is owed by `Clause-②: yes (widening)` alone.
- **Item 2: attribute mapping.**
  - Both SSO register forms gain optional `mapEmail`/`mapFirstName`/`mapLastName`/`mapName` (SAML), merged into `mapping` beside the existing groups claim. A blank field sends nothing, so an existing form submission builds the same config.
  - Two new platform-admin-gated bridges answer only `{ providerId, protocol, email, firstName, lastName, name }`. They are `POST /api/v1/auth/admin/sso/get-attribute-mapping` and `…/set-attribute-mapping`, both gated by `gateAdmin` ahead of any read or delegation, with route-ledger rows and conformance.
  - `set` changes only the members it is given; null or absent keeps a member, and blank removes it. It refuses `firstName`/`lastName` on an OIDC provider with `400`. It re-dispatches into the vendor's `/sso/update-provider` with the stored mapping plus the change, because the vendor replaces the whole mapping. It answers the mapping as read back.
  - `sys_sso_provider` gains the two actions, gated by `PLATFORM_ADMIN_SETTINGS_GATE` and `isPlatformAdmin`. Their standing pins are in `platform-objects.test.ts` and `platform-admin-affordance-standing.test.ts`. Translations are regenerated for 11 locales.
- **Item 3: SAML refusal cause.**
  - It runs only inside the vendor's opaque `saml_error` refusal (`runSsoSamlRefusalCauseScope`) and replaces only its `error_description`, with one of a closed list of four causes: IdP status not success, unsigned, signing-certificate mismatch, issuer mismatch. An unclassifiable response keeps the vendor's text.
  - It decides nothing. The vendor has already refused, and no response is accepted or rejected on this module's reading.
  - XML is parsed with `fast-xml-parser` and `processEntities: false` (no entity expansion), after `XMLValidator`. Signature-wrapping shapes (`Assertion`/`Signature` under `SubjectConfirmationData`) and `EncryptedAssertion` stay unclassified.
- **New dependency:** `fast-xml-parser@5.10.1`, pinned exactly in `plugin-auth`, with the lockfile updated. It was covered by claim amendment 6764776096.

### ② Semver level

`patch` on the touched packages with `Clause-②: yes (widening)` on body and changeset. The changes are two new routes, two new actions and optional form fields. No existing answer changes, except that a refused SAML sign-in's `error_description` becomes more specific. Agreed.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Auth boundary:** not loosened. The new doors are platform-admin gated before any work. The refusal diagnosis runs after the vendor refuses and only names the cause, and a forger learns nothing their own response does not already tell them.
- **Dev findings:**
  - (a) `carrier: cloud`: cloud's `AuthProxyPlugin` must mount the two bridges, or the actions answer 404 on a cloud host. The seat carries this to cloud.
  - (b) Pre-existing dogfood eslint `vitest/valid-title` errors are in untouched files. No action.
  - (c) `SSO_SAML_REFUSAL_CAUSES` is not exported from the plugin-auth entry, unlike the OIDC list. This is outside this card's surface and goes to PR-B or a follow-up.
- **Deviations accepted:** the vendor's own "SAML response validation failed" log line is not held (a second log-sink hook would be needed), and the cause rides as one `warn` beside it. The PR body says 18 ablations where the record has 19.
- **Serial:** #32132 (seat 3) touches the same SAML refusal landing. Whichever lands second merges `origin/main` (seat-3 notify 6764612669).

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-hlv1i9`
Reviewed-by: `session_01WGufzi1tLRTEYwYGtbNCyk`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** SSO 提供方可以配置"登录后这个人是谁"：SAML 的邮箱、名、姓、显示名属性，OIDC 的邮箱、姓名 claim。注册 SAML 表单多了四个可选字段；已有提供方多了"查看/编辑属性映射"两个动作，背后是两个只限平台管理员的接口。SAML 登录被拒时，错误页的说明会给出四种原因之一：证书已轮换、IdP 返回失败、响应未签名、Issuer 不符。
- **为什么改：** Okta 和 Entra ID 用的属性名和厂商默认值不同，这些用户只能以 NameID 命名，平台里也没有地方改映射。IdP 证书轮换后，管理员只能看到一句看不出原因的拒绝。
- **风险与回滚：** 登录接受或拒绝的判定不变，只在厂商已经拒绝之后改写说明文字，`error=saml_error` 不变。编辑映射时没填的项保持原值，组 claim 等其它配置原样保留。新接口在任何读取之前先做平台管理员校验。回滚只需 revert 本 PR。
- **先看：** `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/sso-saml-refusal-cause.ts`（四种原因的判断），再看 `register-sso-provider.ts` 的 "The attribute mapping" 一节。
- **两分钟验证：** `cd packages/plugins/plugin-auth && pnpm exec vitest run src/sso-saml-refusal-landing.test.ts -t 32086`，预期 11 条全过（用真实 samlify IdP 走完四种拒绝原因，以及 Okta、Entra 的映射）。
- **需要你做的：** 无，席位落地。cloud 侧 AuthProxyPlugin 需要挂载这两个新接口，已由席位转交 cloud。

席位意见：ACCEPT。契约复核 PASS（comment 6769359973，TIER_DEFAULT，声明面，钉 811d140c）。之后只并入了 main，PR 自身的 diff 只有一处测试文件注释不同（见下行），所以记录续管。

Regen-provenance: 6769359973 · `811d140c2707a216975f24b7efc3f3659c1c1216` → `8cd810b056c6eda150ae5eab8b843fc13b5eb3d7` · `scripts/pm/os-regen-merge.sh` merge of origin/main `e40f2df2` (one hand-resolved conflict, doc comment only) → packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/sso-saml-refusal-landing.test.ts

## 席位核对

Head-sha: `8cd810b056c6eda150ae5eab8b843fc13b5eb3d7`

1. **Shape.** 41 files, +2272/-17. `Part of #32086` (PR-B closes the card under ruling 6764924025). `Clause-②: yes (widening)` and `Metadata-protocol: none` on body and changeset. Surface = claim 6764573689 plus amendments 6764693228 and 6764776096.
2. **Premises measured.** Per-file comparison of the PR's own diff, `merge-base..811d140c` against `e40f2df2..8cd810b0`: 41 files on both sides, 40 byte-identical in their changed lines. The one difference is the `RpOptions.samlConfig` doc comment in `sso-saml-refusal-landing.test.ts`: #32193 landed the same option and spread on main, so the branch now adds only the merged comment. No code line was resolved by hand.
3. **Gates (check-runs at 8cd810b0).** 69: 60 success, 9 skipped, 0 failed; `mergeable_state` clean. K = 11 against PRBASE `0eca80a7` (the Plan Test Core shards log); no new language pack landed in that range (`git diff --diff-filter=A` on locale and translation paths: none), so the ten regenerated bundles stand. The dev's post-merge local run, 122 derived gates with 0 NOT-MEASURED, is at /mnt/project-files/issue-32086/gates-ran-8cd810b0.list.
4. **Deviations accepted.** As recorded in 6769359973: the vendor's own "SAML response validation failed" log line is kept, with the cause as one `warn` beside it.
5. **Out of scope, routed.** (a) cloud `AuthProxyPlugin` mounting the two bridges: carried to cloud by the seat. (b) Pre-existing dogfood eslint `vitest/valid-title` errors in untouched files: dropped — not this diff. (c) `SSO_SAML_REFUSAL_CAUSES` not exported from the plugin-auth entry: Acceptance notes, owed by PR-B. `Skills-docs: none`.
6. **Landing.** `check-governed-merges --pr 32188` reads 0 of 41 paths governed and 2289 lines, so it is Tier S. The seat lands it.
